topic: A student is accused of plagiarism
text: I have to say, when the accusation hit the air, I felt a calm I didn’t expect. It’s a curious thing, being under a cloud that seems so dark to others, yet to me, it shimmered with the light of challenge. I know the work, every word, every thought. It’s woven from the threads of countless nights and the silences between my ears. To hear those ideas called borrowed, it’s like someone mistook the ocean for a puddle, not realizing the depth, the vastness. But that’s alright, misunderstandings are but whispers in the wind. I’m ready to turn this into something more—after all, how else would we grow if not for tests of character?
